nativeRules: StyleItem overrides from a common style are bound to the layer defining the item. Borrowed aliases do not change that layer.
The selected common style may contain values for items owned by its extension, including in a borrowed common style.
Standard common-style color roles remain shared across layers.
Explicit Type/Value on a borrowed item, placed after ObjectBelonging in native order, are retained and used when the selected style has no value in its defining layer.
A matching base common-style value takes precedence over the modified fallback Value.

architecture.styleItemIdentity: The first definition in the ordered context fixes the common-style table layer. A later Value override remains an effective fallback and does not move the item.
